scope: Clearance room/egress progress and locality-resume coordinate consistency
finding: Arrival checks already use absolute floor/body geometry, but room best-distance, mover motion, supporting motion, exit retry distances and resumed exit progress used direct getPosATL vector distances against points from different terrain cells. Resumed arrived-exit validation also retained a terrain-relative height comparison. Changing terrain under two points can inflate distance/motion or reject same-floor settlement.
implementation: Use getPosASL for live actor measurements. Convert native AGL room/exit targets with AGLToASL and saved getPosATL actor-motion samples with ATLToASL. Apply the same metric at initial exit records, checkpoint transition, retry target, best-distance/progress updates and locality reconstruction. Preserve native destinations/previous-pose format, native command identity comparisons, journals, one-metre thresholds, retry counters and original deadlines.

officialReferences.meaning: AGL and ATL coincide over land but differ over water.

validation.notes: Existing floor test extended with an unequal-terrain false-motion example and source integration checks. Two older exact ATL-expression assertions updated to require ASL at the same one-metre threshold. Final sealed build includes explicit ATL-vs-AGL distinction.

cost: Conversions inside existing bounded progress checks. No additional geometry/world/roster scan, worker, timer or callback. Runtime cost unmeasured.
limitations: Corrects distance interpretation, not native pathfinding/building access. No claim that this explains historical flat VR failures. Physical slope/multistorey/shoreline/owner-transfer/repeated-entry behavior remains unverified.
provenance: Unsigned dirty development snapshot based on517bcf4c plus implementation and unrelated pre-existing dirt. Private review/handover and one documentation format clarification postdate package; production sources unchanged after build.
